english.title: To deceive made / possessed a document closely resembling one issued / required under an environmental permit condition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with intent to deceive

(A)_[made]_
(B)_[had in your possession]_

a document, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..), so closely resembling one

(C)_[issued]_
(D)_[authorised to be issued]_
(E)_[required]_

for a purpose under an environmental permit condition as to be likely to deceive
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 38(4)(d)(ii) and 39(3) of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2010.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Er mwyn twyllo gwneud/meddiannu dogfen tebyg iawn i un a gyhoeddwyd/yr oedd ei hangen dan amod trwydded amgylcheddol

Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) gyda'r bwriad i dwyllo, bu i chi

(A)_[wneud]_
(B)_[feddiannu]_

dogfen, sef **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..), a oedd mor debyg i un

(C)_[a gyhoeddwyd]_
(D)_[a awdurdodwyd i'w chyhoeddi]_

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit or Prosecutions:
None.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
